resources.string: Take control of your screen. Choose which apps appear in grayscale to reduce distractions and stay focused.
GrayGate needs usage access to detect which app you\'re currently using. This lets us know when to switch grayscale on or off.
GrayGate needs a one-time permission to control your display\'s grayscale mode. This requires running a command via ADB (Android Debug Bridge) from a computer.
To keep GrayGate running reliably in the background, disable battery optimization for this app. Otherwise, your phone may stop it from working.
GrayGate is ready. Head to the app list to choose which apps should be grayscaled.
